import math

from numba_cuda_mlir import cuda
from numba_cuda_mlir.cuda import libdevice as ld

FT = np.float32
F32 = np.float32
U32 = np.uint32
TWO = FT(2.0)
ONE = FT(1.0)
ZERO = FT(0.0)
BAIL = FT(1e12)
Z32 = F32(0.0)
ONE32 = F32(1.0)
HALF32 = F32(0.5)
BIG32 = F32(3.0e38)
DENS32 = F32(5.0)
TRAPX = F32(0.25)
TRAPY = F32(0.1)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def two_sum(a, b):
    s = ld.fadd_rn(a, b)
    bb = ld.fsub_rn(s, a)
    e = ld.fadd_rn(ld.fsub_rn(a, ld.fsub_rn(s, bb)), ld.fsub_rn(b, bb))
    return (s, e)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def quick_two_sum(a, b):
    s = ld.fadd_rn(a, b)
    e = ld.fsub_rn(b, ld.fsub_rn(s, a))
    return (s, e)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def two_prod(a, b):
    p = ld.fmul_rn(a, b)
    e = cuda.fma(a, b, -p)
    return (p, e)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def w_add(ah, al, bh, bl):
    s1, s2 = two_sum(ah, bh)
    t1, t2 = two_sum(al, bl)
    s2 = ld.fadd_rn(s2, t1)
    s1, s2 = quick_two_sum(s1, s2)
    s2 = ld.fadd_rn(s2, t2)
    return quick_two_sum(s1, s2)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def w_sub(ah, al, bh, bl):
    return w_add(ah, al, -bh, -bl)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def w_mul(ah, al, bh, bl):
    p1, p2 = two_prod(ah, bh)
    p2 = ld.fadd_rn(p2, ld.fadd_rn(ld.fmul_rn(ah, bl), ld.fmul_rn(al, bh)))
    return quick_two_sum(p1, p2)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def w_sqr(ah, al):
    p1, p2 = two_prod(ah, ah)
    p2 = ld.fadd_rn(p2, ld.fmul_rn(ld.fmul_rn(TWO, ah), al))
    p2 = ld.fadd_rn(p2, ld.fmul_rn(al, al))
    return quick_two_sum(p1, p2)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def w_mul2(h, l):
    return (ld.fmul_rn(TWO, h), ld.fmul_rn(TWO, l))


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def w_from(a):
    return (a, ZERO)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def c_mul(ar_0, ar_1, ai_0, ai_1, br_0, br_1, bi_0, bi_1):
    xr_0, xr_1 = w_mul(ar_0, ar_1, br_0, br_1)
    yr_0, yr_1 = w_mul(ai_0, ai_1, bi_0, bi_1)
    rr_0, rr_1 = w_sub(xr_0, xr_1, yr_0, yr_1)
    xi_0, xi_1 = w_mul(ar_0, ar_1, bi_0, bi_1)
    yi_0, yi_1 = w_mul(ai_0, ai_1, br_0, br_1)
    ri_0, ri_1 = w_add(xi_0, xi_1, yi_0, yi_1)
    return (rr_0, rr_1, ri_0, ri_1)


@cuda.jit(fastmath=False)
def k_df64_Z(c0r_0, c0r_1, c0i_0, c0i_1, dx, max_iter, row0, out_f, out_u):

    h = out_u.shape[1]
    w = out_u.shape[2]
    yy = y + row0
    if x < w and yy < h:
        ox = FT(x - w // 2)
        oy = FT(h // 2 - yy)
        pr_0, pr_1 = w_from(ld.fmul_rn(ox, dx))
        pi_0, pi_1 = w_from(ld.fmul_rn(oy, dx))
        cr_0, cr_1 = w_add(c0r_0, c0r_1, pr_0, pr_1)
        ci_0, ci_1 = w_add(c0i_0, c0i_1, pi_0, pi_1)
        zr_0, zr_1 = w_from(ZERO)
        zi_0, zi_1 = w_from(ZERO)
        r2 = ZERO
        n = 0
        while n < max_iter:
            x2_0, x2_1 = w_sqr(zr_0, zr_1)
            y2_0, y2_1 = w_sqr(zi_0, zi_1)
            r2 = ld.fadd_rn(x2_0, y2_0)
            if r2 > BAIL:
                break
            m_0, m_1 = w_mul(zr_0, zr_1, zi_0, zi_1)
            m2_0, m2_1 = w_mul2(m_0, m_1)

            zr_0, zr_1 = w_add(q_0, q_1, cr_0, cr_1)
            zi_0, zi_1 = w_add(m2_0, m2_1, ci_0, ci_1)
            n += 1
        out_u[0, yy, x] = n
